digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Wednesday, November 11, with 14 meetings, two protected work blocks, and nine candidate carry-overs awaiting the publication workflow’s fresh-state check. First, protect the Atlanta, Dallas, and Salt Lake City Amazon Connect rollouts while forcing a clear answer on the AWS user-capacity risk for later waves; then settle the 11:30 AM, 1:30 PM, 3:30 PM, and 4:00 PM calendar collisions. Use the 3:00 PM EPMO Product session to close the handoff and prioritization decisions, and address the recurring intake-access routing problem early. The repository state snapshot is from November 6, so the workflow will refresh completion and hidden state before pruning carry-over items.

items.label: Protect today’s Amazon Connect rollout wave
items.detail: Atlanta, Dallas, and Salt Lake City are scheduled to transition between noon and 1:50 PM AST. Current office waves remain cleared, but the AWS request for 400 additional users still needs an impact readout for later waves; keep routing, voicemail ownership, user eligibility, and the RingCentral desk-phone dependency visible in the go/no-go discussion.

items.label: Close the Product handoff and escalation loop
items.detail: The group’s feedback on the Product-to-EPMO handoff has now been sent. Use the 3:00 PM special Product session and the Laura 1:1 overlap to confirm the prioritization, intake, initiation, and escalation decisions that still need owners.

items.label: Route Maribel’s intake-ownership access request correctly
items.detail: A fresh project-intake notification shows the access request is still landing in the CoE portfolio. Confirm the IT/HALO owner and close the routing gap so the request does not continue cycling through project intake.

items.label: Capture the remaining holiday-coverage follow-ups
items.detail: Tuesday’s update confirms Washington DC, Tampa, and Nashville transitioned successfully with minor issues under monitoring. Close the remaining coverage loop by recording any unresolved deployment or Conversation Analytics follow-up that needs an owner.

items.label: Review and sign the two AI policy documents
items.detail: Rippling is still waiting on the AI Tool Development Policy and AI Tools Quick Reference Guide, both FRAP No. 002. Complete both signatures in one pass.

items.label: Complete the LeadUp growth-mindset follow-up survey
items.detail: This has remained open since October 23. Finish the short follow-up separately from the new Module 4 pre-work due next week.

items.label: Close the follow-ups from the rollout and leadership coverage decisions
items.detail: Confirm that Tuesday’s meeting collisions did not leave an unowned Product, CSC, or Amazon Connect follow-up, then close this item once the remaining owner is explicit.

items.label: Complete the overdue EPMO Asana pain-points poll
items.detail: The poll was due yesterday and remains unchecked in dashboard state. Submit it early so the team’s workflow friction is represented before today’s EPMO discussion.

items.label: Bring a decision-ready EPMO readout into today’s Product session
items.detail: Use the updated portfolio material and EPMO metrics deck to isolate decisions on the Product handoff, Sales Cloud Pre-Intake, Revenue Cloud, Knowledge Management, and Service Cloud priorities. Resolve Nicolas’s question on whether the Venn December 18 target belongs in the slide or only in the working update.

items.label: 10:30-11:00 AM - Thiago 1:1
items.detail: Use the 1:1 to confirm rollout ownership, the AWS user-limit impact for later waves, and which issues need escalation before the live sessions begin.

items.label: 11:30 AM-12:00 PM - Resolve the Change Management and standup collision
items.detail: Change Management Guidance and the Amazon Connect standup occupy the same calendar slot. The standup body says it moved to 3:00 PM ET, but the occurrence still shows 11:30 AM AST; confirm the real time and choose coverage.

items.label: 12:00-2:00 PM - Protect the rollout sequence and choose 1:30 PM coverage
items.detail: Atlanta overlaps the blocked hour, followed by Dallas and Salt Lake City. Salt Lake City then overlaps the 1:30 PM Universal Intake kickoff and Nicolas 1:1, so delegate at least one commitment before noon.

items.label: 2:30-4:00 PM - Astrid 1:1 and the Product decision block
items.detail: Astrid’s 1:1 leads into the special EPMO Product session at 3:00 PM. At 3:30 PM, the session overlaps both Lisinski Celebrates in Spanish and the Laura 1:1; keep the Product forum primary unless the decision owner is delegated.

items.label: 4:00-5:00 PM - Resolve the portfolio, CoE, and focus-time collision
items.detail: Operations Portfolio Review, the CoE Biweekly Touchpoint, and focus time all begin at 4:00 PM. Mar also asked for the IT biweekly meeting to be moved, so confirm which meeting that request affects before the block starts.

items.label: Lock coverage for today’s four collision points
items.detail: Confirm the real Amazon standup time, assign coverage for the rollout and 1:30 PM meetings, protect the 3:00 PM Product session, and decide the 4:00 PM portfolio-versus-CoE priority before the day compresses.

items.label: Move the IT biweekly meeting requested in Teams
items.detail: Mar asked Jean to move today’s IT biweekly meeting. Identify the correct calendar occurrence, propose a workable replacement, and confirm the change with the affected attendees.

items.label: Review the new Supabase security vulnerability alert
items.detail: An unread Supabase message says action is required for security vulnerabilities in current projects. Open the project findings, confirm whether they are new or recurring, and assign remediation rather than relying on older completed alerts.

items.label: Schedule the LeadUp Module 4 pre-work
items.detail: Rippling says the Leading with Strategy pre-work is due November 17. Reserve a completion window this week so it does not join the older LeadUp follow-up in carry-over.

items.label: 10:30-11:00 AM - BD Portfolio Review
items.detail: Bring the latest risks, blockers, and new intake decisions; Gustavo is out tomorrow, so confirm whether his absence affects any portfolio input.

items.label: 11:30 AM-12:00 PM - Armando 1:1 and Amazon standup conflict
items.detail: Both occupy the same slot, followed by a protected noon block. Decide coverage today and preserve the work block unless a rollout issue requires escalation.

items.label: 1:30-5:00 PM - Maria, Sara, and the weekly team meeting
items.detail: The afternoon is sequential rather than conflicted: Maria 1:1 at 1:30 PM, Jean/Sara at 2:30 PM, then the Tudo Bem weekly meeting at 4:00 PM.
